topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: Well, this is odd, isn’t it? We found this tin box, all old and rusty, buried right where we were fixing the fence. I never buried no such thing, and I doubt anyone in these parts did. It was strange to see it lying there, like a secret buried deep in the earth, just waiting to be found. I opened it up, and inside were some old coins, a piece of cloth, and a letter written in a hand I don’t recognize. The coins are from a time long past, a time before I tilled this soil. It made me think about how much has changed, and how much stays the same. The world goes on, and the seasons change, but we keep planting, hoping for a decent harvest.
